name: hub_code
description: Fulfillment center facility code (NL-TILBURG-01, IE-DUBLIN-02, DE-FRANKFURT-01, ES-MADRID-01)

name: country_code
description: Facility country ISO code (NL, IE, DE, ES)

name: sku_id
description: Google Store hardware product SKU (FK to products_catalog.sku_id)

name: on_hand_stock
description: Physical unit inventory count present in warehouse shelves

name: reserved_preorders
description: Units allocated to pending customer preorders awaiting dispatch

name: safety_threshold
description: Minimum safety buffer stock threshold. Calculation formula: safety_threshold = (Average Daily Dispatch Volume x Replenishment Lead Days) + Safety Buffer Margin. Set between 200 and 500 units depending on hub tier.

name: replenishment_lead_days
description: Estimated transit days required for stock replenishment from manufacturing source

name: stock_status
description: Operational inventory health status governed by business rule: 'CRITICAL_BACKORDER' if (on_hand_stock - reserved_preorders < 0) [triggers immediate automated replenishment alert]; 'CONSTRAINED' if (on_hand_stock - reserved_preorders <= safety_threshold); 'HEALTHY' if buffer margin is satisfied. Valid enum values: HEALTHY, CONSTRAINED, CRITICAL_BACKORDER.
